mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 70 degrees with clear skies over at Reddan Soccer Park.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous council vote. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community input, will guide our local growth, housing, and infrastructure projects for the coming decades.
We have a busy schedule ahead, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Looking into tomorrow, you can check out trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Regarding the recent police report, an incident occurred on September 28 at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M where a driver was cited for failing to maintain control of their vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day at Culver's is Georgia Peach. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
